items.name: Diamond
items.description: The birthstone for April, the diamond isthe hardest of all metals and retainsits form for decades and centurieswithout losing its sparkle.

items.name: Pearl
items.description: The birthstone for June, the pearl isa biogenic mineral produced bypearl shells. Even Japan, with its lackof mineral deposits, was able to offerthe world its share of beautiful jewelrythanks to its use of pearl farming.

items.name: Sapphire
items.description: The birthstone for September,the sapphire was considered a symbolof the clergy in medieval Europe, witheven the Pope sporting a sapphire ring.It is a blue gem symbolizing loyaltyand purity.

items.name: Emerald
items.description: The birthstone for May, the emerald hasa long history going back to ancientBabylonia, where it was traded. QueenCleopatra was a fan of its greenglimmer.

items.name: Ruby
items.description: The birthstone for July, the name rubycomes from ruber, the Latin wordfor red. Its passionate color offersthe courage to pursue one's goaland is said to make one's romanticwishes come true.

items.name: Jade
items.description: The birthstone for May, jade is a greenjewel with more of a history in Japanand China than in the West.It symbolizes authority and status.

items.name: Opal
items.description: The birthstone for October, the opal isa beautiful gem that glitters in manydifferent colors. It was known as the gem of the godsin ancient Rome, where it was held invery high esteem.

items.name: Amethyst
items.description: The birthstone for February,the amethyst is named after Amethystos,a servant to Diana,the Greek goddess of the moon,whose story ended in tragedy.

items.name: Peridot
items.description: The birthstone for August, the peridothas an olive glimmer that has beenbelieved since ancien times to havethe power to heal and ward off evil.

items.name: Turquoise
items.description: The birthstone for December, turquoisehas long been considered a sacred stonein many parts of the world. The ancientEgyptians offered it as giftsto the gods Osiris and Isis.

items.name: Garnet
items.description: The birthstone for January, the garnet'samber glow was said to have acted asa guiding light for Noah as he sailedthe dark, flooded world in his ark.

items.name: Topaz
items.description: The birthstone for November, the topaznormally comes in yellow, but can alsobe found in blue, green and pink.It symbolizes friendship and hope.

items.name: Coral
items.description: A birthstone for March,coral is a biogenic mineral producedin the sea. Coral is said to bringluck and beauty to young womenin Scotland, and is used in the jewelryhanded down among the British royalty.

items.name: Aquamarine
items.description: A birthstone for March, aquamarine hasa translucent blue color like the sea.European sailors once considered thisgem to contain the powers of the seaand kept them as lucky charms.

items.name: Philosopher's Stone
items.description: A lovely gem that countless alchemistsonce attempted to find. Perhaps it wasformed by the indefatigable dreams ofthese men, who never gave up in theirfruitless pursuit.It can be used with a demon of any racewhen performing Crystallize Demon,and will increase the success rate.

items.name: Egg of Pangu
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this strange egg containsthe very essence of the earth.

items.name: Ten Commandments Tablets
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,the tablets have been inscribed withthe ten covenants formed betweenthe One True God and the Savior.

items.name: Oracle Mirror
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this mirror was handed down to men byone who was once revered as a god, sothat he may convey his wishes directlyto them.

items.name: Crown of the Abyss
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this crown symbolizes the highest rankattainable in the world that lurksin the darkest depths of the earth.

items.name: Bird's Spittle
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this mystical ingredient is said tohave once been used by the Dvergar incrafting the magical collar Gleipnir.

items.name: Cat's Footfall
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this mystical ingredient is said tohave once been used by the Dvergar incrafting the magical collar Gleipnir.

items.name: Platinum Spirit Money
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this platinum coin was once buriedalong with the bodies of the dead.If silver spirit money is used to paythe demons that dwell in hell,and gold spirit money is used to paythe deities that live in the heavens,to whom would platinum spirit moneybe offered?

items.name: Damascus Chakram
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this disc-like throwing weapon wassaid to have been crafted out ofa sacred metal by ancient gods.Indians attempted to replicate thismetal in the medieval period, but whatthey created was refined in Damascus,which is where Damascus steel gets itsname. It is a difficult weapon forhumans to wield.

items.name: Amenonuboko
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this spear was left behind by theKotoamatsukami, gods even more ancientthan the Heavenly Gods and NationRulers, and is a difficult weapon towield.

items.name: Astral Crystal
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this crystal formed from materializedastral matter contains a highconcentration of spirits of greatpurity that control alignment.

items.name: Necronomicon
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this evil tome contains spellsfor controlling the dead.The twisted poet who authored thisbook is said to have been devouredalive by an invisible monster.

items.name: Cintamani
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this sacred jewel is said to have beenlocated below the jaw of a dragon.Coral stars float within the jewel'sorb, and those who possess it are saidto be granted any wish they desire.

items.name: Rheingold
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this sacred material has the powerto fulfill the desires of its owner.Although valueless as a metal due tothe numerous impurities it contains,magical rings and helmets are said tohave been crafted from this gold.

items.name: Leather of Amalthea
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this leather was taken off of thehide of Amalthea, the Goat Goddess.Aegis, the shield that Zeus offered toAthena as a gift, is said to have beenmade from this very leather.

items.name: Ark of the Law
items.description: A miracle produced by the handsof humans, this object cannoteasily be recreated.It is made from a similar materialto the Ark that once containedthe Ten Commandments Tablets.

items.name: Mithril Wheel
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifyingan act performed by a powerfar greater than man,this cog was made from a legendary,highly durable and processable metal.Its maker and purpose, however,remain unknown.

items.name: Asada Archive
items.description: An archive full of materialshand-selected by DB Asada. Can be deconstructed with an Extractor to obtain items.

items.name: Strip of Shadow
items.description: An object into which the four oni ofFujiwara-no-Chikata have been trapped.

items.name: OOPTH of Hatred
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this evil tome contains spells for controlling the dead. The twisted poet who authored this book is said to have been devoured alive by an invisible monster. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Healing
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this mystical ingredient is said to have once been used by the Dvergar in crafting the magical collar Gleipnir. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Contentment
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this leather was taken off of the hide of Amalthea, the Goat Goddess. The Aegis shield that Zeus offered to Athena as a gift, is said to have been made from this leather. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Obedience
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, the tablets have been inscribed with the ten covenants formed between the One True God and the Savior. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Wish
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this sacred jewel is said to have been located below the jaw of a dragon. Coral stars float within the jewel's orb, and those who possess it are said to be granted any wish they desire. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Desire
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this sacred material has the power to fulfill the desires of its owner. Although valueless as a metal due to the numerous impurities it contains, magical rings and helmets are said to have been crafted from this gold. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Slight Blindness
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Platinum coin burred with the dead. It's said that Gold Spirit Money is paid to deities and Buddhas Silver Spirit Money is paid to demons of hell. Then for whom was the Platinum Spirit Money made for... Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Little Grief
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Sign of the one who is of the high rank in the world of Abyss. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Little Wonder
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man It's not easy to create the same exact thing. It's supposedly made of the same material as what the 10 Commandment tablet was stored in. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Small Sign
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man The one whom was worshiped as a god gave this mirror to humanity so they can share thoughts. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Little Thirst
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man this mystical ingredient is said to have once been used by the Dvergar The rumor is that it was used to craft the magical collar Gleipnir. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

items.name: OOPTH of Small Celebration
items.description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Mystical egg said to be filled with materials of the earth. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.
